HealthFirst Business Analyst Capstone

How can a simulated hospital define requirements, coordinate stakeholders, analyse appointment and resource data, and plan process changes and risk controls?

IBM learning capstone · CAPSTONE | 6 local-complete, 3 partial

I developed nine related business-analysis labs around the simulated HealthFirst Care case. The pack connects requirements and traceability with stakeholder planning, scope, process models, analysis, a dashboard and risk mitigation. Six labs are complete locally with review open; three retain specific platform or notation requirements.

Approach and tools

The BRD and RTM connect 18 distinct requirement IDs with their sources and planned UAT. The stakeholder analysis, engagement plan and WBS make responsibilities, scope boundaries and change control explicit.

Editable SVG diagrams show current and proposed workflows, role lanes, decisions and rework. They are local diagrams; the specified Lucidchart/Visio tooling and formal BPMN conformance remain separate requirements.

The analysis uses 200 appointment records, 198 substantive feedback records and 200 resource records. Six missing feedback scores were imputed using the mean 6.270833. Department-level resource comparisons support descriptive analysis rather than patient-level causal claims.

The analysis workbook contains four native Excel PivotTables, six slicers and four charts. The dashboard has four native pivots, six slicers and two charts. Desktop Excel checks found no formula errors or external connections. Selecting Cardiology changed the appointment KPI from 200 to 38 and updated the chart series; resetting restored both.

The risk register and SWOT identify ten risks with likelihood/impact scores, controls, owners, triggers and contingencies. The dynamic 3×3 matrix recalculated when R01's likelihood was changed.

  • Microsoft Excel
  • PivotTables and slicers
  • Requirements traceability
  • Stakeholder and scope analysis
  • Editable SVG process models
  • Risk analysis
  • Python pandas and NumPy

Nine labs and their current status

  1. 1. Requirements and RTM

    Local complete; review open

    BRD, requirements traceability workbook and findings report; 18 IDs and planned UAT.

  2. 2. Stakeholder analysis

    Local complete; review open

    Stakeholder matrix, analysis and engagement plan, with editable matrix diagram.

  3. 3. Scope and WBS

    Local complete; review open

    Scope/change-control report, WBS workbook and editable hierarchy and branch diagrams.

  4. 4. As-Is and To-Be models

    Partial: tool requirement

    Editable local SVG process models exist; requested Lucidchart/Visio authoring is unfulfilled.

  5. 5. Process maps and swimlanes

    Partial: BPMN notation

    Editable role-lane diagrams exist; BPMN conformance has not been validated.

  6. 6. Data cleaning and analysis

    Local complete; review open

    Separate analysis workbook and report, native pivots, slicers and charts.

  7. 7. Dashboard

    Partial: platform requirement

    Excel dashboard, interaction guide and PDF exist; the Cognos/Looker exercise is unfulfilled.

  8. 8. Risk register and SWOT

    Local complete; review open

    Ten-risk register, SWOT, controls, triggers and report.

  9. 9. Risk matrix and mitigation

    Local complete; review open

    Dynamic matrix, mitigation workbook, owners and contingency plans.

Scope and limitations

  • Course profiles and datasets are simulated. The pack does not claim hospital approval, executed UAT, deployment, pilot results or measured operational benefits.
  • Native PivotTables and slicers need desktop Excel for the verified interaction. Browser previews and other spreadsheet applications may not preserve every control.
  • The earlier 39-slide hospital case study uses a separate dataset. Its 206 valid appointment records and findings are not the basis of the nine-lab capstone.

Next steps

  • Review the completed local lab outputs against stakeholder requirements.
  • Complete the specified Lucidchart/Visio and Cognos/Looker exercises and validate BPMN notation.
  • Agree acceptance criteria and execute UAT before any real deployment or benefit claim.
